content.short: Unified execution layer for on-chain FX across stablecoins, tokenized deposits and yield tokens.
content.description: Superset argues that on-chain FX is held back because stablecoin liquidity is split across isolated pools and chains. It pulls that liquidity into one open market for fiat-backed stablecoins like USDC, EURC and XSGD, tokenized bank deposits such as JPM Coin, and yield-bearing tokens like BUIDL and USDY, so trades and cross-chain settlement get consistent pricing.
content.meta: Superset merges stablecoin, tokenized deposit and yield-token liquidity into one market for on-chain FX.
